tagline: Govera mifananidzo yezvidimbu zvechando uye kwevera kune yakanakisisa. Mahara, pasina kushambadza.
nav.label: Menyu
login.title: Pinda neGoogle
login.why: Pinda kuti ugovere mifananidzo, uchengete zvaunoda uye uvhote.
login.why.like: Zvakanaka! Pinda kuti uchichengete uye upe mutori wemufananidzo moyo.
login.privacy: Tinochengeta chete nhamba kubva kuGoogle nezita remadunhurirwa raunosarudza. Kwete zita rako, email kana mufananidzo wako.
login.needed.favorites: Pinda kuti uchengete zvidimbu zvechando zvaunoda.
login.needed.mine: Pinda kuti uone mifananidzo yako nemimoyo yako.
login.needed.upload: Pinda kuti ugovere mufananidzo wekadimbu kechando.
nick.title: Sarudza zita remadunhurirwa
nick.why: Vamwe vanoona zita iri pamwe chete nemifananidzo yako. Mavara kana nhamba 3 kusvika 24.
nick.label: Zita remadunhurirwa
swipe.title: Tarisa zvidimbu zvechando
swipe.empty: Waona zvidimbu zvese zvechando. Dzoka gare gare, kana ugovere chako!
report.title: Mhan'ara mufananidzo uyu?
report.why: Hausi kadimbu kechando, hausi mufananidzo wake, kana haukodzeri? Kana wamhan'arwa kakawanda, unobviswa kusvikira waongororwa.
top.title: Zvidimbu zvechando zvakanakisisa
fav.title: Zvaunoda
fav.empty: Kwevera kurudyi kadimbu kechando kaunoda, kozooneka pano.
mine.title: Mifananidzo yangu
upload.title: Govera kadimbu kechando
upload.why: Zvidimbu zvechando chaizvo chete, zvawatora iwe pachako. Mufananidzo wega wega unoongororwa usati waiswa paInternet. Ruzivo rwenzvimbo runobviswa otomatiki.
upload.consent: Ndakatora mufananidzo uyu wekadimbu kechando ini pachangu, uye Snowflakes inogona kuuratidza. Ndinogona kuudzima chero nguva.
upload.done: Ndatenda! Mufananidzo wako wakamirira kubvumidzwa. Unogona kuutevera paMifananidzo yangu.
account.title: Akaundi yako
account.delete.why: Izvi zvinodzima zita rako remadunhurirwa nemifananidzo yako yose, mimoyo nezvaunoda. Hazvidzoserwi.
account.delete.confirm: Chokwadi dzima akaundi yako nemifananidzo yako yose?
privacy.title: Zvakavanzika
privacy.1: Kutarisa nekukweva zvinoshanda pasina akaundi. Hapana chinoteverwa uye hapana kushambadza.
privacy.2: Ukapinda neGoogle, tinochengeta chete nhamba yeakaundi yeGoogle nezita remadunhurirwa raunosarudza. Kwete zita rako, kero yeemail kana mufananidzo weprofile.
privacy.3: Mifananidzo inoderedzwa mubrowser yako isati yatumirwa; izvi zvinobvisawo ruzivo rwenzvimbo nerwekamera. Tinochengeta mifananidzo yako, zvawakweva nezvawamhan'ara.
privacy.4: Dzima akaundi yako pano zvese zvobva zvaenda. Mibvunzo? Vhura issue paGitHub.
admin.title: Ongorora mifananidzo
